title: Bug: chunked requests fail when header Content-Length is set
description: When sending chunked transfer encoding, setting Content-Length causes the connection to stall or raise ProtocolError.

title: Documentation states Flask 2.0 requires Python 2.7
description: The setup.py says Python >= 3.6, but the issue reporter claims documentation says Python 2.7 is mandatory.

title: Intermittent timeout on custom async loop under heavy load
description: User experiences random socket timeouts under a custom event loop architecture with non-standard SSL proxy.

title: Incorrect timeout inheritance in Client child requests
description: Child requests do not inherit client base timeout when timeout=None is explicitly provided.

title: Validator decorator claims to execute before root validator in all cases
description: Reporter claims field validator executes before root validator regardless of pre=True/False flags.
